records.body:

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero product activity: no first project, no invite, no key milestone. No reply to the welcome email (email:c44aac4e) and no tickets, so no signal of engagement; internal handoff note (slack:f02317d8) suggests no owner attention. Silent accounts this cold rarely self-activate in 8 days.

draft.subject: Getting Clearwater Dynamics started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Following up on my welcome note from last week. Most teams get their footing in Wrenfield by setting up a first project -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything about getting your team in.

Best,
Priya
